claim_text: “That was what people thought as they spoke” and “people who thought they were speaking with AI were actually speaking with human staff.”
issue: The Ledger establishes that trained human contractors made some Muse calls and that the test began without proper disclosure, but it does not establish what the recipients believed about who was calling.
local_context:
# The AI Phone Call Had a Human Helper

An AI called. That was what people thought as they spoke. But a human appeared from behind the scenes. A test involving Muse, Meta’s AI agent, became a reveal of what was really happening.

### The human backup plan
